implementationDetails.audioStrategy: One deterministic render pipeline (src/audio/render.ts + src/audio/effects.ts + src/audio/dsp.ts + src/audio/organ-models.ts + src/audio/synth-engine.ts + src/audio/synth-render.ts) serves both the browser and tests. Grand/Upright/Electric pianos play the bundled recorded sample library; Clav/Digital/Misc, the labeled fallback, all organ models, and all synth voices are honest live synthesis rendered per voice. The Web Audio backend pre-renders each voice through the exact shared graph (layer source → Mod 1 → Mod 2 → Delay → Amp/EQ/Filter → Compressor → per-voice frames) and plays it through six layer buses (pianoA, pianoB, organ [A+B shared], synthA/B/C), a live convolver reverb, layer level gains, master gain, and a DynamicsCompressor limiter to one destination on one AudioContext. The fake test backend runs the identical code offline at 8 kHz. Organ routes to the shared Rotary via the ORGAN button (post-reverb tap, like To Rotary); rotary speed ramps (acceleration), and Stop mode silences the modulation. Programs store/recall the complete canonical state (32 slots + 8 Live) through an injected storage seam; splits gate/attenuate notes per layer with crossfade tails; morphs interpolate assigned destinations through canonical state; the master clock drives arp/LFO sync subdivisions.
